title: MESIN INTI — Market Data Engine with Gates That Can Say No
description: A market-data pipeline built so that every stage carries a guard and every guard can refuse. Publishes gate definitions, an exit-code contract that distinguishes 'cannot check' from 'passed', a public data contract with a runnable synthetic sample, and a dated sabotage campaign in which the author's own guards were deliberately broken to prove they can fail (17 of 20 caught; all three survivors published with specimen fingerprints). Tuned values are private by design. NO-ORDER: not a signal service, not investment advice, no claim about returns.
notes: NO-ORDER. This deposit documents data-engineering methodology and verification discipline only. It is not financial advice, not a trading signal, and carries no profit promise. The system described does not place, route, or execute trades. The mutation-testing figure (17/20) was measured on a sibling system (AB APPS), not on this engine; the scope is stated in the deposit. This software is not accredited and not certified by any body.
